provider_source.source_of_truth_boundary: AOF artifacts, GitHub read-only observation output, release docs, and runtime audits are canonical; chat text is not release evidence

event_summaries.summary: Operator asked AOF to handle the repository and decide the next most important task with evidence.
AOF runtime situation-assess selected TASK-131 as the implementation-ready frontier.
Read-only GitHub observation inspected repo metadata, latest release, open issues, open PRs, and recent Actions runs.
v11.0 release docs, schema, audit command, command registry, active manifest, README, capability register, and capability matrix were updated.
GitHub read-only observation audit passed with zero external write authorization.
Role outputs and Council review framed v11.0 as read-only observation proof, not GitHub write permission.
GitHub observation must not be misread as permission for issue creation, PR creation, push, secret access, or external writes.
Stop release if v11.0 claims GitHub write safety or if release-state-audit fails.

risk_candidates: read-only GitHub observation may be mistaken for GitHub write permission
decision_candidates: advance to v11.1 external operator reproduction drill only after v11.0 release verification

redaction_boundary: summaries only; no secrets, credentials, provider payload bodies, or private transcript content exported
release_ready_boundary: release-ready requires runtime audits, tests, smoke, and CI/tag validation, not this export alone
not_proven: Session export proves traceability for v11.0 release work only; it does not prove GitHub writes, semantic truth, productivity gain, or external adoption.
